title: Novel guanidine derivatives as mechanistic scaffolds for anticancer agents: synthesis, characterization, DNA-binding, and computational studies
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,31548-31563
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05647K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Hina Zaman, Aamer Saeed, Uzma Azam, Ghulam Shabir, Madiha Irfan, Basant Farag, Hesham R. El-Seedi
Novel guanidines are synthesized as DNA minor groove binders. Spectroscopic and DFT studies revealed that EDGs synergize with halogens to enhance binding affinity, offering promising scaffolds for anticancer drug design.
